orientation: Print as exported: 4 mm plate flat on the bed (Z=0), standoffs and countersink cones open upward. In service the plate hangs vertically on the wall; the only loads are wood-screw clamping (compression through Z, fine) and the ~46 g Pi cantilevered 5 mm off the standoffs (negligible bending across standoff layers). No load puts layers in Z tension except insert pull-out, which the melted insert bond spans across layers.

issues.message: No overhangs, no bridges, no supports needed. Insert pockets (blind, from standoff top) and countersinks (cone opening upward at z=4) are all vertical-axis features; no horizontal holes, so no teardrops required.
issues.evidence: printability_auto: overhang_area 0.0 mm2, overhang_regions []; plate_sections.png XZ@Y=0

issues.message: Bed edges carry a 0.8 mm 45 deg chamfer (chamfer, not fillet); bed contact 7287 mm2 on a 119 x 64 footprint. PETG on a part this size has low warp risk.
issues.evidence: printability_auto: bottom_chamfer_area 386.8 mm2; plate_sections.png XZ/YZ show the chamfer; views.png BOTTOM ISO

issues.message: Thinnest wall 1.65 mm is the top 0.3 mm of each standoff, around the 4.7 mm insert lead-in counterbore ((8.0-4.7)/2). Below it the standoff wall is 2.0 mm (5 lines), above ruthex min 1.6. Pocket 4.0 mm x 7.1 mm deep (6.8 + 0.3 lead-in), floor at z=1.9 leaves 1.9 mm solid under each pocket. Insert hole intentionally uncompensated per ruthex table.
issues.evidence: printability_auto walls.min_thickness 1.65 at z~8.8 near (-39,24.5),(19,24.5); measure holes: Ø4.0 z1.9-8.7, Ø4.7 z8.7-9.0

issues.message: Countersinks at x=+/-49: Ø9.36 mouth, 90 deg cone, 4.4 mm shank bore only 1.32 mm long at the bed face (z 0-1.32); ~1.6 mm of material under the cone at r=2.5. Adequate for wall clamping, but over-torquing a wood screw could pull the head through. Edge distance to plate end 10.5 mm (>= 2 x 4.4). First-layer squish may tighten the 4.4 bore slightly at the bed face; 0.4 mm clearance absorbs it.
issues.evidence: measure holes: Ø4.4 len 1.32, Ø9.36 at z 3.79-4.0; measure ray x=51.5 material 1.62 mm
issues.fix: hand-tighten wall screws; optionally raise plate to 4.8 mm or add a 0.4 mm chamfer on the bed-side bore edge

issues.message: Standoff root fillet is 1.0 mm (project CLAUDE.md asks >= 2.0 on interior corners). Within the reviewer's 1-2 mm band and the load is negligible (Pi weight only), so acceptable.
issues.fix: optional: increase ROOT_FILLET to 2.0 for margin

issues.message: Fits printer bed (119 x 64 x 9 vs P1S 256^3); low, wide part, no tip-over risk.

print_settings.walls: 5 (makes the 2.0 mm standoff walls fully solid perimeters around the inserts)
print_settings.bed: textured PEI (or glue stick on smooth PEI), 70-80 C
print_settings.notes: Install ruthex M2.5x5.7 inserts with an iron at ~230-245 C for PETG, pressing straight down; the 0.3 mm lead-in centres them. Use M2.5 screws <= 6 mm thread engagement past a 1.6 mm PCB. Do not over-tighten the 4 mm countersunk wood screws.
